thread:
nina (customer): Hey support — after we triggered a scheduled purge for project-acme last week, a few objects are still showing up in search. Notable id: obj_987654. This is urgent for our compliance team.
sarah (support): Sorry about that — we'll look. Can you paste the exact API call + timestamp when you issued the delete? Also which retention policy was in effect for that project?
nina (customer): We called the delete API around 2026-03-10T18:12Z.
Request we used:
```
DELETE /v1/projects/acme/objects/obj_987654 HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```
Response: 202 Accepted

But when we run a GET now we get 200 and the object is searchable.
GET response snippet:
```
GET /v1/projects/acme/objects/obj_987654
200 {"id":"obj_987654","deleted":false,"metadata":{...}}
```
Our project policy: custom retention = 30 days (we verified in console). We expected immediate tombstone then background purge within 48h.
sarah (support): Thanks. I'm escalating. @miguel can you check the deletion queue + worker logs for obj_987654 and any related KMS/HSM errors in the March 9-11 window? Also @john please advise on legal hold if we need to stop any auto-purge.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-20260312-42 and assigned to infra. Link: https://incidents.example/inc/INC-20260312-42
miguel (infra): I see a deletion task enqueued for obj_987654 at 2026-03-10T18:12:23Z. Worker attempted purge but failed during envelope decrypt step. Log tail:
```
2026-03-10T18:12:24Z ERROR purge_worker decrypt_failed key_id=kms-prod-17 err="HSM unwrap error: session timeout"
2026-03-10T18:12:24Z WARN purge_worker requeued job object=obj_987654 attempts=1
```
Looks like there was an intermittent HSM session failure; purge worker requeued but subsequent runs show the job stuck in backoff for longer than expected. Also our search index snapshot still contains the doc (index pruning runs after storage-level purge).
miguel (infra): Action plan: 1) we'll surface the audit logs for the delete request, 2) attempt a manual purge now that the HSM health check passed, 3) if legal asks, we can flip a soft-hold flag to prevent purge while preserving logs. @leo (security) FYI about HSM transient failures.
john (legal): Please place any objects related to project-acme on hold immediately — we need to preserve for potential discovery. Do not perform destructive purge until legal confirms. Also export an immutable copy of the audit trail for the window 2026-03-09..2026-03-12.
sarah (support): Understood. @miguel please don't run the destructive purge until legal confirms. Can you instead perform a non-destructive worker replay to gather the failure context and pull full audit events? Also notify the customer of next steps.
miguel (infra): Copy. I will: 1) mark obj_987654 with hold=true in retention metadata, 2) pull purge worker logs + KMS audit entries and attach to INC-20260312-42, 3) run a dry-run replay to surface errors. Sample query I'm using for the queue:
```
SELECT * FROM deletion_queue WHERE object_id='obj_987654' ORDER BY enqueued_at DESC LIMIT 10;
```

Preliminary audit entries found:
- 2026-03-10T18:12:23Z DELETE_REQUEST user=nina@acme.com request_id=req_abc123
- 2026-03-10T18:12:24Z KMS_UNWRAP_FAILED key_id=kms-prod-17 err="session timeout" request_id=req_abc123
- 2026-03-11T02:03:00Z WORKER_RETRY attempt=2 backoff=3600s

I'll attach logs to the incident shortly.
leo (security): Noted. KMS session timeouts look like a transient HSM cluster issue; security will review HSM telemetry. Do we have a rotation or maintenance event around 2026-03-10? If so, document it in the incident notes.
nina (customer): Appreciate it. Legal hold is requested — we need the object preserved and a full export of any access logs for that object. We'll provide a POA if required.
sarah (support): Thanks. John — do you need any specific format for the audit export? We can provide raw audit JSON + a CSV timeline. Also confirm whether legal wants a freeze on billing for retained copies while hold is active.
john (legal): Raw audit JSON + signed export manifest preferred. Billing hold: request that finance flag this for review; we don't need to block charges automatically but please record the ask in the incident.
miguel (infra): Done: hold flag set for obj_987654 (retention_hold=true). Attached logs to INC-20260312-42. Next steps: wait for legal sign-off, security to review KMS/HSM telemetry, infra to re-run purge workflow in dry-run mode. If legal releases hold we can schedule immediate purge window.
sarah (support): Noted — I'll update the customer thread and add the incident link. Nina, we'll follow up within 2 hours with the exported audit and confirmation of hold flag.
nina (customer): Thanks — holding tight for the export. :pray:
